csv_project_name: CM for UNH Williamson and Christensen Halls Renovation
csv_scope_of_work: The University System of New Hampshire, representing the University of New Hampshire (UNH), is seeking construction management services to provide preconstruction and construction services for the renovation of Williamson and Christensen Halls at UNH. This solicitation is open to all qualified firms eligible to do business in the State of New Hampshire. It is the intent of UNH to use a Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) form of delivery. The Construction Manager will be engaged at the conclusion of Schematic Design and will collaborate with the selected Design Professional throughout Design Development, Construction Documents, and Construction Administration.
